name: Last Tide
subtitle: Shipwreck Island Survival
promotionalText: The Last Tide is coming. Build your camp, rescue the survivors and take back the islands from Red Jack before his ship sails without you.
description: Your ship is gone. The sea has left you on a beach with a few planks, a torn sail and a dog called Biscuit. Survive, build a camp, and find a way off the islands before the Last Tide.
GATHER, CRAFT AND BUILD
- Chop palms, break rock, fish the shallows and hunt wild boar.
- Craft tools, weapons and clothes at your workbench, campfire and stations.
- Build your camp piece by piece: floors, walls, storage boxes, a rain catcher and a shelter against the storms.
- Upgrade your stations to make iron harpoons, cutlasses and stronger gear.
EXPLORE THE ARCHIPELAGO
- Sail a raft across a hand-drawn sea chart to eight islands: Wreck Cove, Palm Grove, Driftwood Shore, Limestone Ridge, Fisherman's Pier, the Old Lighthouse, Smuggler's Cave and the Pirate Camp.
- Each island has its own coast, wildlife and loot that washes back in while you're away.
- Day turns to night: sneak past danger in the dark, or light a fire and hold your ground.
RESCUE THE SURVIVORS
- A waterlogged radio picks up calls for help. Follow them to old Tomas, Mara and her brother Ned.
- Each one has a story, and a part to play in the plan to beat Red Jack.
FIGHT FOR THE ISLANDS
- Giant crabs, vipers, drowned smugglers and Red Jack's raiders stand between you and home.
- Biscuit fights at your side. Sneak, strike and pick your battles.
- Storm the Pirate Camp, face Red Jack and sail his ship out on the Last Tide.
KEEP PLAYING
- Level up and claim rewards on the Survivor's Path.
- Seasons and events every couple of weeks, with new companions to unlock.
Last Tide is free to play. Optional in-app purchases include doubloons, packs, a bigger backpack and season rewards. Nothing is needed to finish the story.
Made by Rushing Technologies.
